warnings: FOUR OF THE ELEVEN SYMBOLS ARE DEFINED BUT NEVER USED ON EITHER SN PLAN: RD (roof drain), RL (rain leader), FCO (floor clean out) and ก็อกสนาม (garden tap) appear in this legend and on no plan in the set. Only FD is actually tagged, in the bathrooms on A-11/A-12/A-13. This is the same 'scheduled but not used' case as the urinal in A-13's fixture table - a series-wide standard legend rather than a per-house take-off. Recorded as printed; no plan element was invented to match them.

THE FOUR LINE-STYLE ENTRIES (CW, V, S, W) ARE WHAT MAKE THE PLANS READABLE - each pipe run on SN-01 and SN-02 is annotated with one of these letters plus a diameter. They are recorded as legend entries here and referenced by the pipe elements on the plan files.
